name: Drake (Draconic Bloodline)
body:
Drake sorcerers and bloodragers are descended by ancient drakeriders: the bond they created with a drake left a trace in their bloodline. A drake sorcerer’s magic is less refined and more brutal than the one used by other draconic spellcasters.

Variant Bloodline Arcana: You use your Constitution, rather than your Charisma, to determine all class features and effects relating to your sorcerer class, such as bonus spells per day, the maximum spell level you can cast, the save DCs of your spells, and the number of daily uses of your bloodline powers. Your drake companion also gains 1 free drake power at 1st level.

Drake Type	Energy Type	Breath Shape
Cairn	Acid	30-foot cone
Crag	Fire	60-foot line
Fjord	Cold	60-foot line
Gare	Fire	30-foot cone
Ice	Cold	30-foot cone
Sea	Electricity	60-foot line
Taiga	Electricity	30-foot cone
Tarn	Acid	60-foot line
Tor	Fire	30-foot cone
